resources.string: Lets an AI client you connect read the screen and tap for you, only during a session you start.

Latch uses this service to read what is on the screen and to tap, swipe, and type when an AI client you connected asks, but only during a session you start, only for the capabilities you switch on, and never in password, PIN, one-time-code, or payment fields. A red Latch button stays on screen while a session is active; tap it to stop everything. Actions that send, buy, delete, or publish wait for your approval. Turn this service off at any time to stop all of it.
Shows while an AI client can use this phone, with a Stop button.
An AI client can use what you allowed. Tap Stop to end it.
Paused. The AI client can do nothing until you resume.
Says when Latch has updated itself.
Your pairing and settings are kept. Tap to open Latch.
